drivingQuestion: What novelty is in the teaching that these birds are diverse kinds?

segments.he: פְּשִׁיטָא! אָמַר רַב חֲבִיבָא: מִשּׁוּם דְּרָבוּ בַּהֲדֵי הֲדָדֵי – מַהוּ דְּתֵימָא: מִין חַד הוּא; קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן.
segments.en: The Gemara asks: Isn’t this «obvious;» what novelty is stated here? «Rav Ḥaviva said:» The novelty here is «because» they are «reared together. Lest you say:» Since they are reared together, they «are» essentially «one species,» and not considered diverse kinds. Therefore, it «teaches us» that they are actually separate species, and the halakhot of diverse kinds do apply to them.
